title: Nightscout : missing BGs
symptom: In AAPS, when set to update Nightscout only when charging, the last BGs are not filled up, leaving holes in the BGs on Nightscout. Full resync does not fill the holes.
cause: The missing BG backfill was a Nightscout bug, not an AAPS bug.
fix: Updating Nightscout to v15.0.2 Dev resolved the backfill issue; when on charge, AAPS backfills the BGs and there are no more holes.
evidence_quote: Good news : the missing BG backfill was a NS bug. Now, when on charge, AAPS is backfilling the BGs. There are no more holes.
